o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish طُوزْ (duz), from Proto-Turkic *tūŕ.
Borrowed from Classical Persian لاجوردی (lājwardī). By surface analysis, lacivərd (“lapis lazuli”) + -i.
